query:
SELECT c.user_id, ts_rank_cd(c.about_tsv, q)::real AS "rank!"
           FROM candidates c, to_tsquery('russian', $2) q
           WHERE c.specialization = $1 AND c.grade IS NOT NULL
             AND c.visible AND c.search_status <> 'closed'
             AND c.about_tsv @@ q
           ORDER BY c.user_id
